description:
Builds the profiling executable that runs the LDPC batch decoder cases a sampled-profile series records.

## Background

The profile of `dev/active/3be770d5` attributes the single-frame decoder's time to categories by source span and records counter groups at one, six, twelve and twenty-four workers. Its series runs a profiling executable under a session script, each session under its own host acquisition, and its summarizer resolves each sample to a category. The lane route widens the decoder workspace eightfold per worker, so cache traffic is the limit the counters test. The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. The story's benchmark arms live in the workspace `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms/` with a build identity record under `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/`. The committed profiling executable is pinned to the single-frame decoder of the earlier harness.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A profiling executable in the story's arms workspace runs a named case, a route, a code and a worker count, of the LDPC batch decoder under the control channel of the committed session script, on the lane route and on the single-frame route.
- [hard] REQ-02: It pins each worker and checks per-frame bit errors against the prepared quality record as the benchmark arms do.
- [hard] REQ-03: Its digest is added to the build identity record by the committed recorder, and the existing arms keep their recorded digests.
title: Build the profiling executable of the batch decoder
